title: GBAuto Agent OS Langfuse trace-correlation link v1
description: The correlation contract between one Langfuse trace (or span) and the Supabase evidence rows it produced (ADR-15: schema or trace correlation gaps fail closed). A link carries identifiers and measurements only: it never carries payloads, prompts, outputs, headers, tokens-as-credentials, or any secret-bearing field. Field names align with resources/lib/tracing.py — trace_id/session correlation keys come from attribution_metadata(), and the tokens object mirrors the canonical usage-detail keys emitted by _coerce_usage_details (input, output, cache_read, reasoning, total).

trace_id.description: Langfuse trace id. Same character class as source-event.v1.trace_id so an intake event and its trace link validate against one identifier rule.

span_id.description: Optional observation/span id within the trace. Not a correlation key on its own — a link needs at least one evidence key.

task_id.description: public.kanban_task_proposals.task_id — the board record once a proposal is promoted.

report_ref.description: Published report reference — public.pr_report_receipts.report_url or report_artifact_path. Query strings carrying a credential are rejected.

artifact_ref.description: public.artifact_locations.artifact_id, registry_path, or public_url. Query strings carrying a credential are rejected (presigned URLs belong in the private bucket flow, never in a trace link).

cron_run_id.description: public.cron_runs.tick_id — the managed-cron tick, named cron_run_id here because the physical column is tick_id.

tokens.description: Usage counts, mirroring the canonical keys of resources/lib/tracing.py::_coerce_usage_details. Counts only — never token strings.

cost_usd.description: Trace cost in USD, joins public.langfuse_traces.total_cost.

error.description: Failure classification. Carries a class and a pre-redacted message only — raw exception text may quote credentials and must be scrubbed before it reaches this contract.
